title: Nika Workflow
description: Schema for .nika.yaml workflow files - DAG workflow runner for AI tasks

provider.description: Default LLM provider, custom endpoint name, or provider fallback chain (v0.50+)

oneOf.description: Single provider or custom endpoint name
Provider fallback chain — first = primary, rest = fallback on failure

model.description: Required for LLM tasks. Model to use for infer/agent verbs (e.g., gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-6)

base_url.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g., vLLM, Ollama). Overrides provider's default URL.

include.description: External workflows to merge into DAG (v0.9+)

skills.description: Workflow-level skills for prompt augmentation (v0.6+). Map of alias → skill file path.

additionalProperties.description: Path to skill file (local or pkg: URI)

routing.description: Workflow-level provider routing with fallback chain and strategy (v0.50+)

goal.description: Goal-driven orchestration (v0.52+). When set, an orchestrator agent is appended to the workflow DAG that evaluates task results and can launch additional sub-workflows until the goal is met.
examples: Produce a comprehensive market analysis report
Research and summarize AI safety findings

orchestrate.description: Orchestration configuration (v0.52+). Controls the orchestrator agent's behavior.

max_rounds.description: Maximum orchestration rounds before graceful stop

confidence_target.description: Confidence threshold (0.0-1.0). Agent must self-assess at least this confidence before completing.

agent.description: Optional agent preset name from the agents: block

max_cost_usd.description: Optional cost budget in USD. Orchestrator stops if exceeded.

session.description: Session file path for state restoration

IncludeSpec.description: External workflow to merge (v0.9+ path, v0.17+ pkg)

prefix.description: Prefix for included task IDs (namespace isolation)

McpServerConfig.description: Inline MCP server configuration (stdio or SSE/streamable-http)

command.description: Command to spawn the MCP server (stdio transport)

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command

env.description: Environment variables for the server process

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process

url.description: URL for SSE or streamable-http transport

Task.description: A task in the workflow DAG

id.description: Unique task identifier (lowercase alphanumeric with underscores/hyphens)

with.description: Data bindings from previous task outputs

oneOf.description: Binding reference to an array (e.g., $locales, $inputs.items, $task | parse_json, $task ?? fallback)
Template binding to an array (e.g., {{with.items}}, {{inputs.locales}})

items.description: Array or binding to iterate over

as.description: Variable name for current iteration value

fail_fast.description: Stop all iterations on first failure

oneOf.description: Object form: for_each: { items: ..., as: ..., concurrency: ... }

for_each.description: Array to iterate over in parallel — flat or object form (v0.3+)

as.description: Variable name for current iteration value

fail_fast.description: Stop all iterations on first error

agent.description: Agentic execution task (v0.2+). String = preset reference (e.g., agent: think)

oneOf.description: Agent preset reference — resolved from workflow's agents: block

provider.description: Provider override, custom endpoint name, or fallback chain for this task

oneOf.description: Single provider or custom endpoint name
Provider fallback chain (v0.50+)

base_url.description: Inline base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoint (one-off override)

preset.description: Reference to a named agent from the workflow's agents: block. Inherits provider, model, temperature, and system. Task-level overrides take precedence.

record.description: Record specification for task output compression (v0.48+)

oneOf.description: Shorthand: true enables recording with defaults

context_budget.description: Token budget for task bindings — auto-truncates if exceeded (v0.51+)

routing.description: Provider routing with fallback chain and strategy (v0.50+)

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must complete before this task.

when.description: Conditional execution expression. If falsy (false, empty, null, 0), task is skipped.

oneOf.description: Agent verb (object form only — agent: string is a preset ref)
Verb-less task: decompose-only, depends_on-only, or preset-only

DecomposeSpec.description: Runtime DAG expansion via MCP traversal (v0.5+)

traverse.description: Arc type to follow (for semantic strategy)

mcp_server.description: MCP server to use for traversal (default: novanet)

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for nested strategy (default: 3)

oneOf.description: Simple prompt string (shorthand)

thinking_budget.description: Token budget for thinking (requires extended_thinking: true)

provider_chain.description: Fallback provider chain — try providers in order (v0.12+)

oneOf.description: Simple command string (shorthand)

shell.description: Execute via shell (default: false for security, set true for pipes/redirects)

env.description: Environment variables to set for the command (v0.22+)

follow_redirects.description: Whether to follow HTTP redirects (defaults to true)

response.description: Response mode: full (status + headers + body JSON), binary (CAS store), or slim (metadata only — no body/headers)

selector.description: CSS selector or JSONPath expression (used with extract: selector, text, jsonpath)

delay.description: Delay between retries in seconds (converted to ms)

backoff_ms.description: Serde alias for delay_ms (delay between retries in milliseconds)

mcp.description: MCP server name (must match a key in workflow's mcp config)

server.description: MCP server name (legacy alias for 'mcp', deprecated)

params.description: Parameters to pass to the tool

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the MCP tool call

resource.description: MCP resource URI to read (mutually exclusive with 'tool')

oneOf.description: Builtin tools: nika:import, nika:thumbnail, etc.
MCP tools with server::tool_name syntax (e.g., novanet::search)

provider.description: Provider override or custom endpoint name (native = local GGUF inference)

mcp.description: MCP servers the agent can access

tools.description: Builtin tools the agent can use (nika:read, nika:write, etc.)

token_budget.description: Total token budget for agent execution (v0.5+)

thinking_budget.description: Token budget for thinking (requires extended_thinking: true)

skills.description: Skills to inject into agent context (v0.15.4+)

from.description: Reuse a named agent preset from agents: block

BindingSpec.description: Data bindings from previous task outputs

default.description: Default value if source is null

oneOf.description: Inline JSON Schema object
Path to JSON Schema file

schema.description: JSON Schema for output validation (inline object or file path)

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts on validation failure (v0.10)

oneOf.description: Shorthand: path to JSON Schema file
Inline JSON Schema object
Path to JSON Schema file

schema.description: JSON Schema for output validation (inline object or file path)

oneOf.description: Inline JSON example object (schema derived at runtime)
Path to JSON example file (schema derived at runtime)

from_example.description: JSON example — Nika auto-derives the JSON Schema from this structure

repair_model.description: Model to use for Layer 4 repair (defaults to task model)

strict.description: When true, derived from_example schemas add additionalProperties: false to all objects

manifest.description: Generate artifacts.json manifest at workflow end

oneOf.description: Enable/disable artifact using workflow defaults
Single artifact with options

source.description: Which binding to save (default: task result)

template.description: Template string to render with {{with.*}} bindings (v0.22+)

oneOf.description: Multiple artifacts

LimitsConfig.description: Agent execution limits for cost control (v0.12+)

provider.description: Provider override or custom endpoint name (native = local GGUF inference)

mcp.description: MCP servers the agent can access

tools.description: Builtin tools the agent can use

file.description: External agent definition file (legacy, use from: instead)

RecordSpec.description: Record compression configuration for task outputs (v0.48+)

compress.description: Whether to compress this task's output into a summary

retain.description: Fields to retain verbatim in compressed summary (e.g., ["stats", "findings"])

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for the compressed summary

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence threshold for compression quality

RoutingConfig.description: Provider routing configuration with fallback chain (v0.50+)

fallback.description: Provider fallback chain — tried in order on failure
